_comment: Only needed for scans whose date the user corrected. The logs already say
*that* a date was wrong (dateChanged on the outcome line); what they never
record is what it was corrected to, so the size and direction of the error
have to be supplied here. Everything else — coverage, the rejection
histogram, the false-accept rate — comes straight off the export.
